name: Translate to Italian
description: A voice speaks what you say in Italian. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 151 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Italian model from the Argos Translate package index: Argos Translate (Argos Open Technologies), released under MIT or CC0 (argos-translate issue #533). Trained on OPUS data (EUbookshop, OpenSubtitles, ParaCrawl, WikiMatrix); includes a Stanza English tokenizer (Apache-2.0). Voice: Piper voice it_IT-paola-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, see its model card.
